profiles.name: Claude Dashboard Monitor
args: & { Write-Host 'Claude Dashboard running at http://localhost:3456' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host 'Logs: .claude/hooks/hooks-log.txt' -ForegroundColor Cyan }

profiles.name: KENL PowerShell Modules
args: & { Import-Module ./modules/KENL0-system/powershell/KENL.psm1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Import-Module ./modules/KENL0-system/powershell/KENL.Network.psm1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'KENL Modules Loaded' -ForegroundColor Green; Get-KenlPlatform }

profiles.name: ClaudeNPC Server Suite
args: & { Write-Host 'ClaudeNPC Phase 1 Complete - Ready for Testing' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host 'Phase 2 Roadmap: PHASE_2_ROADMAP.md' -ForegroundColor Cyan }

profiles.name: Network Diagnostics
args: & { Import-Module ./modules/KENL0-system/powershell/KENL.Network.psm1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Network Diagnostics Ready' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host 'Run: Test-KenlNetwork' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

profiles.name: Git Operations
args: & { git status; Write-Host 'Git Repository: claude-landing' -ForegroundColor Green }
